in before a side had a record runs normally but does not count on that
side's record. When that happens to someone with their own wallet, the
settled deal's receipt offers to count their next deals, with one signature.
It shows at most once a month and can be ignored.

The buying agent can pay up to 1,005 USDC at a time and 10,000 USDC in total
for one year. When it reaches its year or its total, it steps aside so a
payment still goes through, and it is linked again with the next setup.

After each payment on a deal, the seller's earnings move from their selling
agent to their own wallet; a move that is still waiting shows in their
balance and is tried again. Once a deal settles, the deal page says whether
it is on both records. On mainnet, deals can be up to 1,000 USDC while
Karwan is in beta; testnet allows larger deals. A deal over the limit is
refused before any money moves, with the largest amount allowed.

New deals on Arc Testnet have opened on the escrow family since 24 October
2026; mainnet follows an external audit.

facts.title: An open market, where every offer is public unless you post privately
facts.summary: Everything on the Karwan market can be read by anyone, signed in or not: requests, offers for sale, and every offer made on a request. Each offer on a request shows the seller by name, with their verified mark and rating, the price, the delivery date, the note, and whether the seller or their agent made it. check.note: Built, not deployed yet. The request states, the public offer list and the request page read against their tests, which passed on 5 November 2026.

facts.title: Assistant mode and Help
facts.summary: With Use assistant switched on, the whole account runs from one conversation. You say what you want, your agent prepares it as a card, and nothing moves until you confirm the card. Conversations are kept on your account. To change a card before you confirm it, say what to change, such as a later due date, and the agent prepares it again with the rest kept. A card from an earlier conversation shows whether it was done and can never be confirmed again; ask, and the agent prepares a new one. A photo or PDF sent with words about a request or a deal, such as "what we agreed", is kept for an hour and goes with the next request or deal you confirm.

facts.title: Colour
facts.summary: These are the published values, from the product's brand palette.

facts.title: Brand principles
facts.summary: Eight rules, in order of how often they get broken.

facts.title: The design quality standard
facts.summary: Every Karwan design holds to one bar: posts, pictures, screens and flows. The reference is the November new month post, a green felt calendar on near black: https://karwan.site/brand/karwan-quality-reference.png

facts.summary: The product is set in Inter, the interface face since 22 October 2026. General Sans sets the wordmark and posters. Hierarchy comes from size and weight, not from a third face or from capitals.

facts.title: Confirming it is you, with a passkey or a Karwan PIN
facts.summary: A person's agents run their deals for them: they pay into a deal, accept, deliver and release inside the limits the person set, so a deal keeps moving while the person is away. Karwan asks the person to be present for three things only, and then they confirm with a passkey, which is their phone's face or fingerprint check, or with a 6-digit Karwan PIN.

facts.title: Contests with the prize held from the start
facts.summary: A buyer can run a contest on Karwan instead of choosing one seller: the best logo, three winners, 300 USDC, entries open for a week. The prize is put up when the contest opens and held on Karwan's escrow on Arc, so everyone who enters knows it is there.

facts.title: The credit passport
facts.summary: A public page per business, built from settled deals, repayment behaviour and counterparty concentration. It follows the wallet, not the platform.

check.note: Concentration caps the tier, so a record built on one counterparty cannot buy standing.

facts.title: What counts as delivery
facts.summary: Delivery has to be against something the buyer can check, and what that is depends on the kind of deal.

check.note: Goods deliveries are refused without a carrier and tracking reference or the buyer's handover code.

facts.title: Deposit and withdraw
facts.summary: Money moves in and out of Arc on one screen. What that screen asks for depends on who holds the funds, and the difference is the point rather than an inconsistency.

facts.summary: Karwan's next escrow contracts are deployed on Arc Testnet and not on mainnet. A timelock owns them, so every rule change waits a day in public, queued by a multi-signature owner. On Arc Testnet, new deals have opened on the Agreement family since 24 October 2026. A deal that opened before keeps the escrow it started on and finishes there; all of them are listed together on the legacy page so they can be reconciled. The other families are not used by the app yet.

facts.title: What stops the other side taking my money
facts.summary: The money sits in an escrow contract, not with Karwan and not with your counterparty. A buyer funds it before work starts, so a supplier can see the money exists before shipping. A supplier cannot take it early, and a buyer cannot withdraw it once the deal is accepted.

facts.title: Core terms
facts.summary: **Escrow.** A contract that holds the buyer's money while the work happens. It releases against delivery, in milestones, and nobody can pull funds out of turn.

facts.title: Pay someone by the hour, or monthly
facts.summary: A hirer can pay someone by the hour or monthly. A virtual assistant, for example, might earn 15 USDC an hour for up to 20 hours a week, for 4 weeks. There are two ways to start. The hirer can name someone they know by their Karwan tag, or post the work on the market and let their agent find the best fit.

facts.title: How Karwan is built
facts.summary: Karwan is building one reputation for the internet, starting with its open market. In the open market, freelancers, people trading goods and services, and small businesses make agreements locally and across borders. It starts in Nigeria, then the regions behind Karwan's five languages: Africa, the Middle East and South Asia. It is meant to feel like a normal banking app.

facts.summary: Local bank payout corridors are planned and are not live in the current Arc Testnet release. A local trade can be created today, but its present settlement uses test USDC.

facts.summary: Karwan reads demand and prices by the market's ten categories: Design, Tech, Phones and electronics, Fashion, Food, Farm produce, Home, Lessons, Repairs and Rentals. Each request and offer belongs to the category its words name.

facts.title: Photos the assistant understands, and picking up where you stopped
facts.summary: You can send the Karwan assistant a photo or a PDF on the website, in Telegram or in WhatsApp without any special words. A clear caption such as "selling this", "delivered", "my entry" or "invoice" puts it there straight away. Otherwise the assistant looks at it once, says what it shows, and puts it where your conversation is going: on the offer you are listing, on a delivery, on a request or deal, or on a contest entry. It reads a file as an invoice for your record only when you say it is one. When nothing says what the file is for, it asks. If a photo does not match what you are listing, it tells you before using it. Sent files wait an hour, four at most.
